title: Nate Robinson On Godzilla: King of the Monsters: ’It Comes Out On My Birthday, I Definitely Plan On Watching It’
htmlContent: Godzilla: King of the Monsters is set to hit theaters worldwide on Friday, May 31, 2019. The latest instal lment of the Godzilla is about Members of the crypto-zoological agency Monarch face off against a battery of god-sized monsters, including the mighty Godzilla, who collides with Mothra, Rodan, and his ultimate nemesis, the three-headed King Ghidorah. When this ancient super-species-thought to be mere myths-rise again, they all vie for supremacy, leaving humanity's very existence hanging in the balance.  Someone that will be excited to watch this next installment will be no other than former NBA guard and three-time slam dunk champion Nate Robinson. He is an avid fan of Godzilla since he was a kid and will be one of the first people in line to see King of the Monsters.  The Movie comes out on his birthday on May 31st and plans on spending part of his day at the theaters. “Of course, it comes out on my birthday. I definitely plan on watching it when it comes out,“ Robinson told me. Robinson is the host of a Facebook Watch series in partnership The Players Tribune called ’House Guest.’ Every Thursday, Robinson gets the opportunity to tour a different celebrities house as they show him some of their most prized possessions such as skateboards, trophies, or even action figures. Robinson will also be participating in the third annual Big 3 season as a part of the team Tri-State.
